deliverables: Open API Layer for Cardano Protocols
12 additional protocol onboardings over 12 months, described as 3 per quarter
MCP server for agents to discover and call published protocols
Auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages and live JSON-RPC endpoints for registry protocols
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe: Open API Layer for Cardano's dApp Protocols, including an open standardized interface, additional protocol onboardings, MCP server, skill framework, and agent-facing documentation.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is presented as a framework where each protocol is described once with a verified interface definition that produces documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints.
The proposal says Catalyst Fund 14 has already put the Tx3 developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal commits to fund 12 additional protocol onboardings, 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage.
The proposer argues that Cardano currently lacks a common interface mechanism across ecosystem protocols, increasing integration cost and limiting composability.
The proposer argues that AI-agent-driven on-chain activity requires shared, auditable interfaces because hallucinated on-chain transactions can move real assets irreversibly.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and cites voting and audit references.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission.
The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

The proposal describes treasury management through Sundae Labs smart contracts, Intersect admin and leadership roles, an external Oversight Committee, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for TxPipe's Tx3 work via Intersect, centered on standardized protocol interfaces, agent-ready infrastructure, 12 new onboardings, and smart-contract-based treasury administration with cited governance and audit references.
